The '''mission on Drongar''' was a mission that [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee]] went on, to the [[planet]] [[Drongar]]<ref name="English Ahsoka and Others" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]],<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> where she encountered the [[dark side of the Force]] when her [[Force-sensitive|Force sensitivity]] was drastically elevated by a natural [[plant]] extract.<ref name="English Ahsoka and Others" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The mission on Drongar originally depicted in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[MedStar Duology]], the 2004 novels ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' and ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''.
